_help: One-time localization inputs consumed by scripts/i18n-translate.mjs. The translate step REFUSES to run until status is 'locked'. To lock: choose a register, set glossaryVersion to 1, set status to 'locked'. Bumping glossaryVersion (or changing register) forces a full re-translation on the next run so terminology stays consistent across every release.
_register_help: 'je' = informal (recommended for Kya's warm voice), 'u' = formal. Must be 'je' or 'u' before locking.
